lines.text_raw: 3mm Allen Driver
lines.text_rendered: 3mm Allen Driver

lines.text_raw: Side Cutter
lines.text_rendered: Side Cutter

lines.text_raw: Zip Tie Gun
lines.text_rendered: Zip Tie Gun

lines.text_raw: 1.5mm Allen Driver 2.5mm Allen Driver 4mm Allen Driver
lines.text_rendered: 1.5mm Allen Driver 2.5mm Allen Driver 4mm Allen Driver

lines.text_raw: INSTALL RIGHT Z MOTOR
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL RIGHT Z MOTOR

lines.text_raw: Install a Motor -2 using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washers.
lines.text_rendered: Install a Motor -2 using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washers.

lines.text_raw: Take note of wire orientation.
lines.text_rendered: Take note of wire orientation.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL LEFT Z MOTOR
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL LEFT Z MOTOR

lines.text_raw: Install a Motor -1 using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washers.
lines.text_rendered: Install a Motor -1 using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washers.

lines.text_raw: Take note of wire orientation.
lines.text_rendered: Take note of wire orientation.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL SMOOTH ROD AND X END MOTOR
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL SMOOTH ROD AND X END MOTOR

lines.text_raw: Slide a 10mm smooth rod up through the bottom of the left Z motor mount.
lines.text_rendered: Slide a 10mm smooth rod up through the bottom of the left Z motor mount.

lines.text_raw: Once you get it started, put the X end motor onto the 10mm rod.
lines.text_rendered: Once you get it started, put the X end motor onto the 10mm rod.

lines.text_raw: Slide the rod in until the end is flush with the top of the Z top flat plate.
lines.text_rendered: Slide the rod in until the end is flush with the top of the Z top flat plate.

lines.text_raw: Use a M3 x 6 set screw to secure the rod in place.
lines.text_rendered: Use a M3 x 6 set screw to secure the rod in place.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL SMOOTH ROD AND X END IDLER
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL SMOOTH ROD AND X END IDLER

lines.text_raw: Slide a 10mm smooth rod up through the bottom of the right Z motor mount.
lines.text_rendered: Slide a 10mm smooth rod up through the bottom of the right Z motor mount.

lines.text_raw: Once you get it started, put the X end idler onto the 10mm rod.
lines.text_rendered: Once you get it started, put the X end idler onto the 10mm rod.

lines.text_raw: Slide the rod in until the end is flush with the top of the Z top flat plate.
lines.text_rendered: Slide the rod in until the end is flush with the top of the Z top flat plate.

lines.text_raw: Use a M3 x 6 set screw to secure the rod in place.
lines.text_rendered: Use a M3 x 6 set screw to secure the rod in place.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL X CARRIAGE AND GUIDING RODS
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL X CARRIAGE AND GUIDING RODS

lines.text_raw: Slide a 10mm rod through one of the two holes in the X end idler.
lines.text_rendered: Slide a 10mm rod through one of the two holes in the X end idler.

lines.text_raw: Once its through far enough, put the X carriage on the rod.
lines.text_rendered: Once its through far enough, put the X carriage on the rod.

lines.text_raw: Finish sliding the 10mm rod through until it's also inserted into the X end motor.
lines.text_rendered: Finish sliding the 10mm rod through until it's also inserted into the X end motor.

lines.text_raw: The rod will be flush with the outside of the X end motor.
lines.text_rendered: The rod will be flush with the outside of the X end motor.

lines.text_raw: Repeat with the second 10mm rod in the second set of holes.
lines.text_rendered: Repeat with the second 10mm rod in the second set of holes.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL X CARRIAGE AND GUIDING RODS (continued)
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL X CARRIAGE AND GUIDING RODS (continued)

lines.text_raw: Using 4 M3 x 12 SHCS, lock the rods in place at the X ends.
lines.text_rendered: Using 4 M3 x 12 SHCS, lock the rods in place at the X ends.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the bolts holding the bearing holders on the X carriage making sure it still slides freely back and forth.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the bolts holding the bearing holders on the X carriage making sure it still slides freely back and forth.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the bolts holding the double bearing holders on the X ends at this point as well.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the bolts holding the double bearing holders on the X ends at this point as well.

lines.text_raw: Does the x carriage slide smoothly back and fourth?
lines.text_rendered: Does the x carriage slide smoothly back and fourth?

lines.text_raw: Did you tighten all the bearing holder bolts?
lines.text_rendered: Did you tighten all the bearing holder bolts?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL LEFT DRIVE ROD
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL LEFT DRIVE ROD

lines.text_raw: Push the end of the coupler tube down onto the Motor shaft.
lines.text_rendered: Push the end of the coupler tube down onto the Motor shaft.

lines.text_raw: Lift up the X/Z axis until you can bolt the Z nut holder to the X end motor.
lines.text_rendered: Lift up the X/Z axis until you can bolt the Z nut holder to the X end motor.

lines.text_raw: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the Z nut holder to the X end motor.
lines.text_rendered: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the Z nut holder to the X end motor.

lines.text_raw: Install large zip ties on the end of the drive rod and on the motor shaft as shown.
lines.text_rendered: Install large zip ties on the end of the drive rod and on the motor shaft as shown.

lines.text_raw: he zip does must be tight enough that you can't pull the drive rod off vertically.
lines.text_rendered: he zip does must be tight enough that you can't pull the drive rod off vertically.

lines.text_raw: Did you pull up on the drive rod to check the zip ties?
lines.text_rendered: Did you pull up on the drive rod to check the zip ties?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL RIGHT DRIVE ROD
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL RIGHT DRIVE ROD

lines.text_raw: Push the end of the coupler tube down onto the Motor shaft.
lines.text_rendered: Push the end of the coupler tube down onto the Motor shaft.

lines.text_raw: Adjust the height of the Z nut holder by spinning it to get it close in height to the X end idler.
lines.text_rendered: Adjust the height of the Z nut holder by spinning it to get it close in height to the X end idler.

lines.text_raw: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the Z nut holder to the X end idler.
lines.text_rendered: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the Z nut holder to the X end idler.

lines.text_raw: Install large zip ties on the end of the drive rod and on the motor shaft as shown.
lines.text_rendered: Install large zip ties on the end of the drive rod and on the motor shaft as shown.

lines.text_raw: The zip must be tight enough that you can't pull the drive rod off vertically.
lines.text_rendered: The zip must be tight enough that you can't pull the drive rod off vertically.

lines.text_raw: Did you pull up on the drive rod to check the zip ties?
lines.text_rendered: Did you pull up on the drive rod to check the zip ties?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL THE PRINT HEAD
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL THE PRINT HEAD

lines.text_raw: Take the print head assembly and seat the bottom of it down into the X carriage assembly.
lines.text_rendered: Take the print head assembly and seat the bottom of it down into the X carriage assembly.

lines.text_raw: Using a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washer, bolt the top of the print head assembly to the X carriage.
lines.text_rendered: Using a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 washer, bolt the top of the print head assembly to the X carriage.

lines.text_raw: Is the print head seated all the way into the X carriage guide?
lines.text_rendered: Is the print head seated all the way into the X carriage guide?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL THE X BELT
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL THE X BELT

lines.text_raw: First cut the belt with a side cutters.
lines.text_rendered: First cut the belt with a side cutters.

lines.text_raw: Route one end through the X carriage as shown and clamp down with a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washer.
lines.text_rendered: Route one end through the X carriage as shown and clamp down with a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washer.

lines.text_raw: Next route the belt around the pulley on the X end motor and the bearings on the X end idler.
lines.text_rendered: Next route the belt around the pulley on the X end motor and the bearings on the X end idler.

lines.text_raw: Finish routing the belt back at the X carriage.
lines.text_rendered: Finish routing the belt back at the X carriage.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL THE X BELT (continued)
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL THE X BELT (continued)

lines.text_raw: Pull tight and clamp down with a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washer.
lines.text_rendered: Pull tight and clamp down with a M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washer.

lines.text_raw: Trim the ends of the belt so they do not interfere with the pulley or bearings.
lines.text_rendered: Trim the ends of the belt so they do not interfere with the pulley or bearings.

lines.text_raw: Check for belt rubbing as you move the X carriage back and fourth. Adjust as necessary.
lines.text_rendered: Check for belt rubbing as you move the X carriage back and fourth. Adjust as necessary.

lines.text_raw: Is the belt nice and tight?
lines.text_rendered: Is the belt nice and tight?

lines.text_raw: Does the belt rub anywhere?
lines.text_rendered: Does the belt rub anywhere?

lines.text_raw: INSTALL THE ELECTRONICS CASE ASSEMBLY
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL THE ELECTRONICS CASE ASSEMBLY

lines.text_raw: Using 4x M5 x 8 BHCS, M5 Washers and M5 T-nuts, attach the Electronics case assembly to the frame.
lines.text_rendered: Using 4x M5 x 8 BHCS, M5 Washers and M5 T-nuts, attach the Electronics case assembly to the frame.

lines.text_raw: Set the bottom of the Electronics case flush with the bottom of the assembly.
lines.text_rendered: Set the bottom of the Electronics case flush with the bottom of the assembly.

lines.text_raw: INSTALL THE LCD CASE ASSEMBLY WITH COVER (not this model)
lines.text_rendered: INSTALL THE LCD CASE ASSEMBLY WITH COVER (not this model)

lines.text_raw: Remove the assembly fixture TL-FX9999 from the corner of the frame.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the assembly fixture TL-FX9999 from the corner of the frame.

lines.text_raw: Using the already installed M5 T-nuts along with 4x M5 x 8 BHCS and M5 Washers, attach the LCD case assembly to the frame.
lines.text_rendered: Using the already installed M5 T-nuts along with 4x M5 x 8 BHCS and M5 Washers, attach the LCD case assembly to the frame.

lines.text_raw: Set the edge and top of the LCD case flush with the outside of the frame.
lines.text_rendered: Set the edge and top of the LCD case flush with the outside of the frame.

lines.text_raw: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the LCD cover.
lines.text_rendered: Using 4x M3 x 12 SHCS and M3 Washers, attach the LCD cover.
